title: A Geometric Capacity Formula for the Fine-Structure Constant
content: The fine-structure constant is usually treated as an empirical dimensionless coupling of quantum electrodynamics. This paper proposes a different interpretation: α−1 is a universal geometric capacity of the neutral-parent structure from which electromagnetic read-out becomes possible. In this view, branch-level electric charge is not primitive; it is an oriented read-out of a resolved defect, while magnetic response is a loop-level holonomy read-out of the completed neutral parent. A neutral object may therefore have no net electric charge while still possessing magnetic holonomy capacity. The leading neutral-parent capacity is formulated as the stratified Haar capacityΩP0=(2π)(2π2)+12(2π2)+12(2π)=4π3+π2+π,
